knowledge:
- key_parameters: template=Path to an alternate RMarkdown template file in writeHtmlReport() ;; usePlotly=Logical value (TRUE/FALSE) to enable interactive plotly-based plots ;; plotType=Specifies the visualization style (e.g., "boxplot", "line", "paracoord") in plotting functions ;; duplicated=Logical value in plotReadTotals() to enable/disable showing duplicated sequences ;; nc=Passed to facet_wrap() to determine the number of columns in line plots ;; species=Specifies the species name for theoretical GC content comparison in plotGcContent() ;; gcType=Specifies the GC content type ("Transcriptome" or "Genome") in plotGcContent() ;; Fastafile=Path to a FASTA file to generate customized theoretical GC content in plotGcContent() ;; type=Specifies the log file tool type (e.g., "bowtie", "star", "flagstat", "duplicationMetrics", "busco", "quast") in importNgsLogs(), plotAlignmentSummary(), and plotAssemblyStats() ;; which=Specifies which part of the log to import (e.g., "metrics") for duplicationMetrics in importNgsLogs()
- alternatives: shinyNgsreports=A GitHub-based Shiny app (UofABioinformaticsHub/shinyNgsreports) recommended for interactive, GUI-based viewing of FastQC reports
- when_to_use: Use this package when you need to aggregate, visualize, and compare quality control metrics across multiple NGS libraries/samples from FastQC outputs or when you need to parse and plot log files from trimming, alignment, or assembly tools.
- pitfalls: plotSeqContent() with usePlotly = TRUE can be very slow to render due to how plotly renders graphics ;; plotBaseQuals() with plotType = "boxplot" may not be suitable for datasets with a large number of libraries ;; importNgsLogs() only supports importing a single log file type at any one time

workflows.name: fastqc_quality_control_analysis
workflows.intent: Parse multiple FastQC reports, extract quality modules, and generate summary and detailed quality plots.
workflows.stages: 1. Load FastQC files into a FastqcDataList ;; 2. Extract specific modules or read totals ;; 3. Generate summary plots of PASS/WARN/FAIL status ;; 4. Plot read totals ;; 5. Visualize base qualities, sequence qualities, sequence content, adapter content, duplication levels, and GC content ;; 6. Export overrepresented sequences to FASTA
workflows.code:
fileDir <- system.file("extdata", package = "ngsReports")
files <- list.files(fileDir, pattern = "fastqc.zip$", full.names = TRUE)
fdl <- FastqcDataList(files)
getModule(fdl[[1]], "Summary")
reads <- readTotals(fdl)
plotSummary(fdl)
plotReadTotals(fdl)
plotBaseQuals(fdl[[1]])
plotBaseQuals(fdl)
plotBaseQuals(fdl[1:4], plotType = "boxplot")
plotSeqQuals(fdl[[1]])
plotSeqQuals(fdl)
r2 <- grepl("R2", names(fdl))
plotSeqQuals(fdl[r2], plotType = "line")
plotSeqContent(fdl[[1]])
plotSeqContent(fdl)
plotSeqContent(fdl[1:2], plotType = "line", nc = 1)
plotAdapterContent(fdl[[1]]) 
plotAdapterContent(fdl)
plotDupLevels(fdl[[1]])
plotDupLevels(fdl)
gcAvail(gcTheoretical, "Genome")
plotGcContent(fdl[[1]], species = "Hsapiens", gcType = "Transcriptome")
plotGcContent(fdl)
plotGcContent(fdl, plotType = "line",  gcType = "Transcriptome")
plotOverrep(fdl[[1]])
plotOverrep(fdl)
overRep2Fasta(fdl, n = 10)

workflows.name: ngs_log_file_import_and_visualization
workflows.intent: Import and visualize log files from adapter trimming, mapping/alignment, and genome assembly tools.
workflows.stages: 1. Import log files using importNgsLogs() ;; 2. Plot alignment summaries using plotAlignmentSummary() ;; 3. Plot assembly statistics using plotAssemblyStats()
workflows.code:
fl <- c("Sample1.trimmomaticPE.txt")
trimmomaticLogs <- system.file("extdata", fl, package = "ngsReports")
df <- importNgsLogs(trimmomaticLogs)
fls <- c("bowtiePE.txt", "bowtieSE.txt")
bowtieLogs <- system.file("extdata", fls, package = "ngsReports")
df <- importNgsLogs(bowtieLogs, type = "bowtie")
starLog <- system.file("extdata", "log.final.out", package = "ngsReports")
df <- importNgsLogs(starLog, type = "star")
flagstatLog <- system.file("extdata", "flagstat.txt", package = "ngsReports")
df <- importNgsLogs(flagstatLog, type = "flagstat")
sysDir <- system.file("extdata", package = "ngsReports")
fl <- list.files(sysDir, "Dedup_metrics.txt", full.names = TRUE)
dupMetrics <- importNgsLogs(fl, type = "duplicationMetrics", which = "metrics")
plotAlignmentSummary(bowtieLogs, type = "bowtie")
plotAlignmentSummary(starLog, type = "star")
buscoLog <- system.file("extdata", "short_summary_Dmelanogaster_Busco.txt", package = "ngsReports")
plotAssemblyStats(buscoLog, type = "busco")
fls <- c("quast1.tsv", "quast2.tsv")
quastLog <- system.file("extdata", fls, package = "ngsReports")
plotAssemblyStats(quastLog, type = "quast")
plotAssemblyStats(quastLog, type = "quast", plotType = "paracoord")
